text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Showing a powerful run in the Shinzan 
Kinen as well, Taiki Shuttle gained 
confidence in sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying this momentum forward, aiming for 
the bare minimum condition toward 
"Umamusume of the Year"... She sets her 
sights on becoming "Best Sprinter"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle decides to enter the NHK 
Mile Cup, the race to crown the 
Classic-class mile champion.
